source_metadata.exact_title: Anticoagulant treatment for subsegmental pulmonary embolism
source_metadata.publication_status: New search for studies and content updated; conclusions unchanged

atom_extraction.source_type_boundary: The source is a systematic review, not primary literature. Atoms represent review-level methods, prespecified outcomes, evidence-gap results, disclosures, and author conclusions; narrative reports of underlying observational studies were not converted into primary-study result atoms.
atom_extraction.assertion_origin_policy: All extracted atoms are normalized_from_source; no calculated clinical effect atoms or extractor-inference atoms were created.

validation_report.pydantic_structural_validation: pass for all atoms (objects were instantiated through LiteratureAtom)

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom model is designed for primary literature and has no dedicated systematic_review_finding or evidence_gap atom kind.
Study-flow counts are methodological review results rather than clinical quantitative effects; they are represented as qualitative_result atoms to avoid fabricating effect-measure context.
The full Methods include RCTs, quasi-RCTs, and CCTs, whereas the abstract selection criteria summarize eligibility as RCTs; the full Methods wording was preserved for the eligibility atom.
extraction_limitations: No eligible comparative studies were included, so the review contains no direct randomized treatment-effect estimates to atomize.
Secondary observational results cited in the Discussion remain secondary reports and were not represented as if the review generated those patient-level results.
The source reports a major-bleeding hemoglobin threshold of 2 g/L; this unit was preserved rather than silently corrected.
